```php
<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\User;
use Faker\Factory as Faker;

class UserSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        $faker = F faker::create();

        for ($i = 0; $i < 100; $i++) {
            User::factory()->create([
                'name' => $faker->name(),
                'email' => $faker->unique()->safeEmail(),
                'password' => bcrypt('secret'), // You should use a stronger password hashing algorithm in production
                'role' => 'admin', // or any other roles you need
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
